// Architecture
// ------------
// Two arithmetic stages and a two-entry output FIFO.
//
//   stage 1 (comb, at the input pins):
//       exact product  prod = x*scale - offset*scale   (48-bit signed)
//       The shared term offset*scale is formed once for all four lanes,
//       each lane needs only a 16x16 multiply and a 48-bit subtract.
//

//       sampled with that word (A5).
//
//   stage 2 (comb, ra -> FIFO): round-ties-away in the magnitude domain,
//       saturate to 32 bits, or the exact fp16->fp32 conversion. The two
//       modes share no arithmetic (F2); they share only the pipeline and
//       the output register.
//
//   q0/q1 : two-entry ordered output buffer.
//
// Flow control. in_ready is a register (A2). The invariant it maintains is
//       in_ready = !ra_v || cnt < 2        (one cycle delayed)
// i.e. a word is accepted whenever the pipeline register is free or the
// FIFO will have room for it, and this is decided one cycle ahead, so no
// combinational path from out_ready to in_ready exists. Capacity is three
// words (ra + q0 + q1): enough to absorb the stall where out_ready drops in
// the cycle a word is accepted (A3), and enough for full throughput (A4).
